name: @ganziliang/pi-auto-classifier
description: Pi extension that judges every final assistant reply against markdown output rules and asks the model to rewrite violations. Ships the TLDR rule, adds a rewrite cap, and supports custom model, API key, and gateway endpoint with an interactive /classifier-
